status: preregistered after c96 qualification and before c128 pilot or candidate measurement
purpose: Test whether 128 pinned users improve Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M TP2 aggregate throughput beyond the qualified c96 endpoint while retaining exact same-shape candidate-vs-control outputs.
hardware: Two local Intel Arc Pro B70 cards; no remote host.
fixed_configuration: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M, llama.cpp SYCL TP2 tensor 1,1, MTP0, normal MMQ Q4_K reorder, WDC paths off, 128 pinned slots, requested total context 32768 (nominally 128x256; record any runtime adjustment), batch 2048, ubatch 256, FUSE_EXT=31, temperature 0, prompt cache off, 128 generated token IDs/request, admission target 128 with 1000 ms fail-safe ceiling.
oracle_rule: Run one fresh cache-off PILOT_MODE control, require 128 complete 128-token batch rows, zero cached tokens, zero collisions and clean health, then commit/hash the pilot-from-batch oracle before candidate measurement. Pilot speed is nonpublishable. Preserve sequential-vs-batch identity separately.
candidate: GGML_SYCL_Q4K_F16_CACHE_FILTER=ffn_down,ffn_gate using exact incumbent Q4_K-to-F16 bytes and unchanged GEMM arithmetic.
advance_rule: Candidate attempt 1 must fit, match the frozen same-shape c128 batch oracle 128/128, pass all completeness/cache/liveness/health gates and exceed the higher qualified c96 observation of 192.350949 tok/s. Only then repeat. Promotion requires both candidates 128/128 and their center above the qualified c96 center of 192.341954 tok/s.
quality_boundary: Same-shape batch identity tests whether the optimization changes any token in the measured c128 workload. It is not a sequential-determinism claim; report the pilot's sequential-vs-batch count separately and never relabel it.
failure_policy: Any pilot failure, candidate mismatch, OOM/health failure or first rate at or below 192.350949 closes r15. No pilot, failed-arm or single-run rate is promoted and no rate transfers to another shape.
